items.title: Cuddly Animal Outfits
items.creator: Withercore
items.description:
Which animal do you feel like today? Choose your favorite animals in these adorable outfits, be it a rabbit, a fox, or even a shark and more - there's sure to be an animal outfit for you. Dress up as your favorite animal outfit and spread happiness by representing your favorite animal!

+ Includes 14 animal themed outfits
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ By Withercore

items.title: Spiritual Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Come and join these spiritual teens!

- 12 Skins
- 1 Free Skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Happy Place
items.creator: Appacado
items.description:
Welcome to your new Happy Place! A complete reimagining of the Minecraft aesthetic, bright and colorful but with soft pastel tones to make it easy on your eyes! Crafted to look beautiful both up close and at a distance.


+ Includes 1.17 textures
+ Reskinned UI

items.title: Wheels on Fire
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to feel like a speedy motorcyclist? With this skin pack, you can put on your costume and go ride through Minecraft. You'll shoot flames at full speed, so take control and be the driver!

- Forty skins in total
- Two free skins
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Teens in Color
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
These teens are colorful and have a lot of style, but above all: they never go unnoticed. Put on one of these skins and see the magic of color in action!

- Twelve colorful skins.
- Two skins totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: The Bridge
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Do you want to have a lot of fun? The Bridge, a mini-game that will put you to the test by building bridges and facing your rival in pvp, has arrived on the market. Who will be the most skilled?

- 2 skins
- 12 large maps
- Multiplayer only
- Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Halloween Furniture
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Welcome to WoolVille. A town that needs your help for Halloween. There are monsters around, lots of houses to decorate, lots of furniture options and you'll have to watch out for the beasts that roam the place! You can play with friends and decorate the whole town!

- 58 Halloween themed furniture options
- 14 skins
- Single and multiplayer
- Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Hallowen Party
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description:
Sweets or treats? Have fun with your friends with a halloween touch. Be the scariest in the entire neighborhood wearing a scary costume!

+ 1 free skin!
+ 12 skins!

items.title: End Temple
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Create your own way to the endworld with this incredible temple, find all the eyes spread around and defeat the ender dragon! Are you ready for this adventure?

items.title: Demon Costumes
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Look at these mystical DEMON costumes! If you choose to buy this pack, you will not regret it!

* 35+ Legendary Uniquely Styled Skins!
* By Giggle Block Studios.

items.title: High School Teen Mobs
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These high school city teen mobs are perfect for roleplay and hanging out!
* 24 awesome mob skins!

items.title: Quack Quack Pack
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Quack Quack Pack! Quackity Quack Quack? QUACK!

-Become a Duck
-Rule your Duck Kingdom
-Roleplay as a Duck

items.title: Domino
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: This is a single and multiplayer domino simulation. You knock down flags to increase your score. Some dominos spin, and some jump, making the challenge more difficult and timing important. Each track has a x10 maximum score over the last one. Each reset of the track erodes your score. You trade score for player-placed dominos so you can create your own domino tracks.

items.title: Pyramid Escape Room
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Can you solve all the riddles to get out of this massive Pyramid? Be on the lookout for mummies!

* Multiplayer Compatible!
* Use your hunting skills to find hidden objects!
* By Giggle Block Studios.

items.title: Sofia's Sleepover
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Grab your pillows, pajamas, popcorn, and games, Sofia is hosting a sleepover and you're invited! 16 sleepover-themed skins including a variety of pajama styles, teddy bears, a skin for the night sky, and a slice of pizza! Have a fun dreamy night with all of your friends with this pack. Download today!

items.title: Blast Drop
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Blast Drop is a fun mini-game where you must survive on a floating platform from the falling TNTs from the sky and challenge your friends to 1v1s with many obtainable cosmetics and power-ups!

- Level up to unlock various cosmetics and look stylish.
- Choose from four difficulties and prove your skills.
- Survive as long as possible to earn more points!

items.title: Fantasy Legends
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Coming out solely to hunt down dragons with their deadly legends and weapons, these warriors and prissiness have lived for millennia.
Their story has awakened these ancient hunters, and they're gathering to rule the lands of the living.
Are you brave enough to create a new story with them?

+8 Legendary skins

items.title: Rooftop Parkour
items.creator: Heropixel Games
items.description:
Get on the roof and experience a new parkour minigame above the rooftops. A new parkour level is generated from many modules, so each round is a unique challenge. Play with your friends – who can collect the most trophies?

+ Generates new parkour levels
+ Custom music and voice
+ Singleplayer & multiplayer
+ 4 skins included!

items.title: Dragon Trainer
items.creator: Heropixel Games
items.description:
Turn into an experienced dragon trainer!

+ Dragon trainer and dragon skins!
+ By HeroPixels

items.title: Mob Hats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Take a little bit of mobs to heart, or, head. Choose from 12 different skins with awesome hats that look like your favorite monsters. Role-play in cool outfits with a passive, neutral or hostile cap like bees, ocelots, or creepers. You’ll have just a little bit of mob in you, or, on you!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Farmer Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s a simple life down on the farm! In adorable overalls, pick up a hoe and get to work. Choose from 12 farm fresh teen skins. Have fun as you role-play getting the fields ready, planting seeds, or picking crops. Don’t forget to take care of your farm animals!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cute Birds
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Puff up your feathers with pride because you’re the cutest bird in town. Choose from 12 adorable skins to flutter and fly all around Minecraft. Do what birds do and role-play building a nest or singing sweetly every morning.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Pastel Astronauts
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Become part of a pastel crew ready to conquer the last frontier! Choose from 12 spacesuit skins in soft colors with hard protections for the challenges in space. Gear up for an amazing astronaut adventure. Role-play as a true explorer ready to discover what’s out there.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cute Pets
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
These are the cutest companions ever! Choose from 12 adorable skins for role-play like dogs, cats, rabbits, and even turtles. Look up at your owner with adorable eyes as you get a pat on the head and make them smile.

1 free skin included!
